thread:
olivia: quick heads-up — hit a bundler -> edge runtime quirk with the JS SDK. Default imports from ESM consumers lead to auth retry flakiness after build. minimal repro available.

ravi: ugh. which bundler/runtime combo?

olivia: reproduces on Vite SSR builds deployed to edge (CF Pages / Workers) and on a Rollup prod build. Dev server usually fine. Symptoms: requests fail with 401 then SDK logs repeated token retry errors. TS also shows default-export/type oddities in some projects.

hao: concrete steps?

olivia: minimal repro steps:
1) npx create-vite@latest app --template react-ts
2) npm i @redwood/inference-js (local dev build)
3) in src/main.tsx: `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'` (default import)
4) build for SSR and run on node or edge. Call endpoint -> see logs: `AuthError: missing token` followed by `RetryAttempt: token fetch returned undefined` and infinite-ish retries.

ravi: does named import avoid it?

olivia: yes — switching to `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference-js'` fixes the runtime flake. Looks like a bundler interop wrapper turns our ESM exports into an object with `.default`, breaking code paths that expect callables.

hao: quick bundler matrix notes: 
- Vite dev: ok (optimizeDeps makes esbuild keep ESM shape)
- Vite build (SSR): fails unless `ssr.noExternal` includes the package
- Rollup: fails if commonjs plugin doesn't convert our dist correctly or if package gets flattened into cjs-shaped chunk
- Webpack: older configs that fallback to CJS can hit the same issue

ravi: workaround list for app teams?

olivia: recommended workarounds we've tested: 
- Prefer named imports (best immediate fix)
- Vite: add to vite.config.ts `ssr: { noExternal: ['@redwood/inference-js'] }` or `optimizeDeps.include: ['@redwood/inference-js']`
- Rollup: enable `@rollup/plugin-commonjs` for node_modules or mark package as external to preserve ESM entrypoint
- Webpack: ensure `.mjs` is processed and treat package as ESM in module rules
- TS: as last resort set `esModuleInterop: true` and `allowSyntheticDefaultImports: true` in tsconfig to silence type issues

doc-bot: CI note — flaky job sample-app-edge-auth (#621) matches these symptoms. Ticket filed.

hao: package-side fixes to consider?

olivia: proposals: 
1) add conditional exports in package.json: "exports": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" } so bundlers pick the correct entry
2) ship a tiny `index.mjs` that re-exports named symbols (no default) to avoid interop wrappers
3) include explicit `types` for both entrypoints and avoid exporting a default in the ESM entry

ravi: can you push a minimal gist with both a Vite and Rollup repro? I'll add a short note to onboarding docs advising named imports and the vite `ssr.noExternal` tweak. We'll add CI matrix tests to catch regressions.

olivia: will push two gists and a short README with exact build commands and logs. tagging @hao for review of the proposed `index.mjs` change. thanks!
